component.name: Orbit Desktop
component.summary: AI development toolkit — scope-aware, daemon-based, multi-engine

description.p: Orbit is the unified entry point for AI-assisted development. It runs as a persistent daemon, maintains structured context across your codebase hierarchy (workspace → tenant → project → repository), and connects natively with any AI engine — Claude, Gemini, or GitHub Copilot.

ul.li: Scope-aware context loading — the right context in every session automatically
Persistent daemon with session history and resumption
Multi-engine: Claude, Gemini, GitHub Copilot — interchangeable
AI planner with scheduled, gate-approved, or event-triggered plans
